id: title:DanielVisca:record a product intent when an agent snippet is copied

observations.behavior: Code now checks copyToClipboard result before calling onCopy; P1.F3 and P6 show this is wired to report a distinct scrape-path intent.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds telemetry for copying agent setup snippets without false positives from failed copies.

observations.behavior: Adds Docker and Kubernetes tabs with CodeSnippet components containing docker/helm commands. P7 shows these trigger reportScrapeSnippetCopied.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides alternative installation instructions alongside existing ones, potentially increasing conversion or at least capturing more users interested in scraping.

observations.behavior: Records ProductIntentContext.METRICS_SCRAPE_AGENT_SNIPPET_COPIED once per session/variant, not repeatedly.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a bounded, repeatable signal that distinguishes genuine interest in the metrics-agent path from generic documentation browsing.

observations.limitations: The change relies on an unreviewed new enum value and its registration across frontend and backend; no tests are shown exercising the full end-to-end flow of snippet-copy -> posthog.capture -> product_intent ingestion. The tier depends entirely on whether this new context actually reaches PostHog's attribution engine as intended.

review.limitations: The change relies on an unreviewed new enum value and its registration across frontend and backend; no tests are shown exercising the full end-to-end flow of snippet-copy -> posthog.capture -> product_intent ingestion. The tier depends entirely on whether this new context actually reaches PostHog's attribution engine as intended.
review.reason: This is a substantive, bounded improvement: it adds a reliable copy-success guard to telemetry and introduces a distinct intent marker for scrape-path adoption without false positives. It does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction or wider capability expansion beyond this specific funnel, so it cannot reach tier 3.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds a cleaner pre-ingestion signal for teams considering the Prometheus agent, which could help activation attribution and reduce noise around generic doc views.
review.uncertainty: Assessment assumes the added ProductIntentContext and reportScrapeSnippetCopied action successfully propagate through existing ingestion and scoring pipelines; no test execution or live behavior is available.
